title: Normalized building definition (legacy items domain, stored type b)
description: Contract for one normalized building: one loaded legacy items entry with stored type b. All numeric legacy strings are coerced to numbers (rule R1), embedded-JSON strings to structures (rule R2), meaningful empty strings preserved and structure-absence empties to null (rule R3); the always-null cost_type is dropped (rule R4). See packages/game-content/README.md for the rule set and survey citations.

legacy_id.description: Stored string item id, preserved verbatim (rule R5).

kind.description: Classification of the stored type field: b maps to building.

source_file.description: Origin file of the loaded entry: config/main.json or the appending patch file.

content_version.description: Content fingerprint (sha256 over stored source plus ordered patches); sources carry no version stamp.

type.description: Stored type field, preserved verbatim (b for buildings).

costs.description: Coerced cost map (rule R2); keys are resource codes, amounts non-negative.

inventory_ids.description: Coerced inventory reference map, or null when the stored value is the JSON null string (rule R2). Keys reference the inventory_items domain, not item ids, and are not item-id validated.

img_name.description: Asset reference, preserved verbatim as observed.

trains_ids.description: Trained unit reference: -1 and 0 mean none; any other value must resolve to a known legacy_id.

upgrades_to.description: Upgrade-chain reference: -1 and 0 mean none; any other value must resolve to a known legacy_id.

best_against.description: Opaque combat flag: numeric codes coerce to integers (rule R1, verified non-resolving against item ids), flag strings and the meaningful empty string are preserved (rule R3/R7).

group_type.description: Grouping label; the meaningful empty string is preserved (rule R3).

premium_upgrade_costs.description: Coerced premium cost map, or null when the stored value is the empty string marking absence (rule R3).

breeding_order.description: Optional patch-added field (atom_fusion_items_data); present only where the patch added it.

sm_training_time.description: Optional patch-added field (atom_fusion_items_data); present only where the patch added it.
